concerns.text: Verification checks chirp-mass bias only 'on high-SNR 16-bit signals', but the cited criterion (US-2 Scenario 1) applies to any quantized waveform with SNR > 10. The verification as written is executable but does not test the condition it claims to verify; specify the bias check over the SNR > 10 quantized set (or all depths) so pass/fail is deterministic against the spec.

'a reduced per-seed batch sized to fit the compute budget' names neither the batch size nor the budget figure, so two implementers can pick wildly different sizes and both 'pass'. State a concrete per-seed batch size (or a formula, e.g. N/10 per seed) and the compute budget (e.g. the 6 h SC-003 bound) in the task description.

PSD source is given as an 'or' choice: "pycbc.psd.from_string('aLIGO_O3actual_L1') or a pinned GWOSC PSD file URL". An implementer cannot deterministically pick one; pin a single canonical source (and, if a file URL, the exact URL) so the fail-loudly loader and reproducibility (Constitution I) are unambiguous.

'record the measured generation runtime and peak memory in manifest.csv header notes' — CSV header comments are a fragile channel for structured measurements; prefer a sidecar JSON (e.g. data/processed/resource_report.json) with named fields (peak_rss_gb, runtime_s) so the verification 'documents measured peak RSS < 7 GB' is machine-checkable.
